messages:
eva: quick heads-up — preflight eval gate failed on the signup_flow prompt set for v2.3.2-canary. holding promotion.

samir: saw the alert. how bad is it?

qa-bot: preflight results:
```
metric: semantic_similarity (avg)
baseline: 0.842
candidate: 0.803
delta: -0.039 (threshold -0.02)
failed_tests: ['signup_flow_end_to_end']
```

linus: delta -3.9% absolute, > threshold. looks like quality regression on completion style.

maya: is this across temperature seeds or bursty? need to know if it's noise.

eva: ran 5 seeds, consistent drop. also flagged increased hallucination rate on one QA subset.

samir: deploy-bot — what was the canary traffic window and fallback?

deploy-bot: canary started 1804506000, traffic ramp 10% -> 30% over 45m. auto-fallback policy is enabled: on eval_gate_fail -> pause rollout, do NOT promote.

jon: thanks. two decisions: 1) pin v2.3.1 for production (stop further canary promotions), 2) triage regression root cause.

maya: agree. also request rollback limit check: do we need immediate rollback on canary?

ops-bot: current canary capacity unaffected. production (pinned) remains on v2.3.1. no rollback executed.

linus: ops — please pin the model version in routing and add a manual hold in console.

ops-bot: pinned routing to v2.3.1 for route `api/generate` (confirmed).

samir: good. next: triage plan. eva, can you open a prompt-eval bisect ticket and attach failing examples?

eva: done — ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/RELEVAL-874. added diffed examples and seeds.

maya: assign to eng-ml and runtime. priority: high. suspect tokenizer/quantization differences in v2.3.2 build.

linus: quick check — did the compile stage pick a new kernel variant? build CI logs show flag `--opt-kernel=kv2` enabled for v2.3.2.

samir: that might change KV cache behavior. add runtime logs and model config to the ticket.

jon: PM sign-off needed before we unhold. @maya can you draft a short risk note for product? include impact numbers and sample diffs.

maya: will do. ETA 45m.

eva: also request a narrower rerun: gate the prompt set with slightly higher beam/seeding to see if it's stable. I can run 1000-sample eval by EOD.

linus: also run a 0.7 quantization back-test to check whether quantization path introduced bias.

samir: if triage points to kernel/quantization, plan: 1) revert the compile flag and rebuild canary 2) or pin a compat-compatible variant for canary only.

jon: timeline — we need resolution within change window (today 1600-2200 UTC). If not resolved, we keep v2.3.1 pinned and postpone release.

maya: noted. adding to release notes draft: "Canary promotion of v2.3.2 is on hold due to preflight eval regressions. Investigating; production remains on v2.3.1."

samir: tracker action items:
- triage started (eng-ml/runtime).
- routing pinned to v2.3.1.
- hold in console set.
- PM notified.

jon: thanks. small ask — if triage finds the regression is acceptable trade-off (latency up, but quality slightly down) we need documented approval from Product and SRE. no soft approvals.

maya: will collect approval threads and mark decision in the ticket.

eva: I'll add failing utterances to the ticket and start the extended eval. posting interim results in this thread.

linus: FYI: I've reproduced the candidate delta locally when compiling with --opt-kernel=kv2 + 4bit quant. repro steps in ticket.

samir: solid. if repro confirmed, schedule a rollback of compile flag and rebuild. ops — how long for a rebuild canary?

ops-bot: rebuild + deploy to canary estimated 18-30 minutes once artifacts ready.

jon: OK. we hold until we have either a fix or a decision to accept with approvals.

maya: pinging @product for decision once triage complete.

qa-bot: follow-up test matrix queued. will post pass/fail summary.

eva: interim eval (30m): semantic_similarity delta -0.038, hallucination rate +1.8% (noticeable). posting sample diffs.

samir: thanks. team — if anyone sees a counterexample where candidate is better, please add to ticket.

linus: adding notes: kernel opt + 4bit quant combo appears to be the root cause in narrow contexts. ref: RELEVAL-874 comment #3.

jon: thanks all. hold remains. I will update release calendar to block promotion for today.

maya: ack. will update release notes and notify stakeholders. :thumbsup:

samir: closing loop: once triage confirms fix, we'll run a fresh preflight eval and require Product + SRE approval to unhold.

eva: will report back in thread with results or decision.

jon: good. end of thread for now.
